desc: Derive prefix-displacement formulation: puff generated at time g sits at P(t)-P(g) at time t+0.5; query reduces to set membership of P(t)-(R,C); generation at origin iff P(t) not in seen.
Write full Python program: fast stdin read, integer encoding of coordinates, loop building output list, print joined string.
Sanity-check logic on sample 1 (got 001010) and confirm order: query and origin-check both use pre-add set state.

Apply the safer encoding constants (OFF = 2*N + 2, W = 4*N + 5) to guarantee injectivity over the full query range [-2N, 2N]; final review confirms correct parsing, direction mapping, generation rule, O(N) time/memory.
